claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made 'in court,' which fails the out-of-court requirement of FRE 801(c).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as a statement made out of court.

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted (that Sandra attacked Nancy).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires the statement to be offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of whether Nancy knew who attacked her, Nancy's statement in court, 'I was attacked by Sandra.'

arguments.text: The statement constitutes an assertion of fact regarding the identity of the attacker.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires the statement to be an 'assertion.'

arguments.text: In-court testimony is inherently non-hearsay because it is made under oath and subject to cross-examination.
arguments.legal_rule: Policy rationale behind FRE 801(c) excludes in-court statements due to procedural safeguards.
